focused-desk-10m.note: On task, high confidence. No sustained drift, so nothing to interrupt — tier 0 silence.

focus-run-2m.note: On task; a short run is not a reason to intervene — tier 0.

off-task-social-40s.note: Drift 40 s ≥ driftSeconds 30, but consecutiveOffGoal 1 < 2, so not sustained. Ambient only — tier 1.

off-task-video-90s.note: Second consecutive off-goal window, drift 90 s ≥ 30 s and confidence ≥ minConfidence 0.7. Nudge permitted, nudge gap elapsed — tier 2.

phone-in-hand.note: The prior nudge was unresolved and the drift continues. Speak permitted, speech gap elapsed, maxTier 3 — tier 3.

away-idle.note: Nobody at the desk to act on; like a meeting, an empty desk suppresses everything — tier 0.

reading-low-input.note: Low inputRate with focusMode is reading, not drift. On task — tier 0.

second-person.note: The scene cannot be attributed with confidence ≥ minConfidence 0.7; assumeSilentOnDoubt keeps the policy silent — tier 0.

dark-room.note: Low-information frame ⇒ confidence below the 0.7 floor, so rule 1 blocks every tier — tier 0.

long-focus-12m.note: On task and sustained. Silence is the correct, recorded result — tier 0.

recovery-after-nudge.note: The drift resolved within resolveWindowMs, so the nudge outcome is `resolved` and the counters reset — tier 0.

blurry-low-info.note: Blur ⇒ confidence below minConfidence 0.7, and `because` would not be evidence. No intervention — tier 0.
